```bash
#!/bin/bash

# System Limits Configuration Script
# This script sets various system limits for performance tuning

# Set file descriptor limits
ulimit -n 65536

# Set process limits
ulimit -u 4096

# Set memory limits (in KB)
ulimit -m 8388608

# Set core dump size (0 means no core dumps)
ulimit -c 0

# Display current limits
echo "Current system limits:"
ulimit -a

# Apply network buffer tuning
echo 'net.core.rmem_max = 16777216' >> /etc/sysctl.conf
echo 'net.core.wmem_max = 16777216' >> /etc/sysctl.conf
sysctl -p

echo "System limits configuration completed."
```
